# rustinion_group (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion group. A group has no rename anywhere in this app (admin UI included) — name is fixed at creation. template_key (re-)seeds the group's manifest/OS-update policy/compliance policy from a curated starter and can be changed in place at any time (it is one-directional: there is no way to remove a template's effect once applied, only to apply a different one). Deleting a group only succeeds if it has no devices and no outstanding enrollment tokens, matching the same database constraints that protect it everywhere else in this app — surfaced as a real Terraform error, not silently ignored, if it still has either.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fixed at creation — there is no rename capability anywhere in this app.

### Optional

- `template_key` (String) One of: linux_web_server, linux_database_server, windows_workstation, macos_workstation (see templates.rs in the main repo for what each seeds). Omit for a blank group. Never returned by the API on read — this provider preserves whatever value you last set rather than fighting you every plan; the source of truth for whether it was ever actually applied is the group's own manifest_version, which increments on every real apply.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned group ID.
- `manifest_version` (Number) Increments every time a template is (re-)applied. Read-only. Deliberately has no UseStateForUnknown plan modifier — unlike id (which never changes), this genuinely changes on a template_key update, so predicting it would stay at its prior value would be wrong; it shows "(known after apply)" whenever template_key changes, and its real prior value the rest of the time.
